en: A vintage black‑and‑white/sepia postcard view of a quiet residential street lined with substantial early‑20th‑century houses. In the left foreground is a villa with a rounded balcony supported by columns and a tiled roof. The street curves gently into the distance with sidewalks, fences, and more ornate townhouses and small trees along both sides. At the top in red Gothic-style print appears the place name and street: "Freiberg i. Sa. Weißbachstraße."
